preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000.
The beauty of each vertex is a non-negative integer not larger than 10^12.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a, b <= n and a != b
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the beauties on all paths (u, v) such that u is ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.

invariants.expression: output = sum(f(u, v) for u in vertices for v in descendants(u)) % 10^9 + 7
invariants.description: The output is the sum of the beauties on all paths (u, v) such that u is ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.
